headline: SFG @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.59 at ATL 5.09, with a projected total of 9.68. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (SFG +0.55, ATL +0.54), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.09, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Grant Holmes has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, Bryce Eldridge, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Willy Adames, Drew Gilbert because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
